one_liner: Front has a documented REST Core API with OAuth2 apps and API tokens, a free developer sandbox account, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with refresh tokens; apps are created in the developer portal and give a client ID and secret. Admin-created API tokens are an alternative for single-company use.
access_notes: Free developer account and sandbox environment with no production data. It is limited to 3 teammates. API tokens can be created there by an admin.
blocker_notes: Public listing in the App Store requires a partner application. Building and testing do not.

evidence.quote: Front's OAuth implementation only supports the authorization code grant type which defines a flow to get a temporary authorization token which can then be exchanged to get an API and refresh token.
There are two ways to get a Bearer token — through API tokens in your settings or through an OAuth implementation
You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.
The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
Front's MCP server lets you and your teammates connect Front to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
